regression_tests.scope: tests/test_piratetok_bootstrap.py; includes real loopback HTTP response limit

server.variant: Previous server probe with registered-runtime.py overlay (anonymous registration, Chrome 136 UA and disabled RFC Ping timeout). Not the same bytes as the local integrated registered bootstrap.

limitations: One public room and ten-minute samples; not long-term uptime validation.
Controlled transport abort is not silent-packet-loss detection.
No independent message-ID set comparison; loss rate unknown.
Anonymous session expiry and production event mapping are not validated by this experiment.
